title: Nyeu Tih Sung

Date 26. 4. 16.

April 24th 1916.

（边注框内文字：Please return this file to the C.I. Department immediately when finished with.）

Sir,
At 2 p.m. 23rd instant the Ningpo merchants in Shanghai held a meeting in their guild in Frenchtown and elected the committee for the coming year. Those present at the meeting all wished to dissociate themselves from the action of Taoyin Chow in sending a telegram to Peking in the name of Ningpo people in Shanghai requesting Yuan Shih Kai to remain President.
Some days ago the rebels seized Wukiang 吴江 south of Soochow and yesterday a number of Government troops arrived from the latter place and drove them away. They fled toward Wang Ting 王亭 which is on the railway near Woosieh. The troops at Woosieh fearing an attack there made preparations on the night of April 23rd to resist it.
It is reported that at 10 p.m. 22nd instant a contingent of six hundred Government troops en route from Woosung to Wusieh were ambused by rebels at a place called Wukiang 吴江 about 30 li from Soochow City. The former being taken by surprise suffered heavily. The result of the fight is now yet known. It is said that Nyeu Tih Sung 鈕鐵生 was at Wukiang with five hundred men. He had established his headquarters in a water police gunboat.
It is reported that Yin Hsien Zung Taoyin of Soochow has deserted his post and is now in Shanghai.
Residents of Soochow and Wusieh are arriving here by all in coming trains.
The S.N.R. discontinued its ordinary service at 11 p.m. 23rd instant and trains are only running as far as Soochow to-day.
Twenty boxes of summer uniform arrived in Chapel yesterday from Woosung for distribution among the troops in the former place.
On the night of the 22nd instant 500 men under the command of Colonel Fong Wei Nien 方維寧 left

I. O. 登记号
第 278 号
日期 1916年4月26日

1916年4月24日。

（边注框内文字：使用完毕后请立即将此卷宗归还刑事侦缉科。）

先生：
本月23日下午2时，在沪宁波商人在法租界的会馆举行会议，选举下一年度的委员会。与会者均希望与道台周（Taoyin Chow）以在沪宁波人名义致电北京、请求袁世凯留任总统之举划清界限。
数日前，叛军攻占了苏州以南的吴江。昨日，一批政府军从苏州抵达并将叛军击退。叛军向王亭（Wang Ting）方向逃窜，该地位于吴淞附近的铁路线上。吴淞驻军因担心当地遭受攻击，于4月23日晚做好防御准备。
据报，本月22日晚10时，一支六百人的政府军部队在从吴淞开往吴淞（Wusieh，原文如此，疑为吴淞或附近地名）途中，在距苏州城约三十里的吴江遭到叛军伏击。前者因措手不及而伤亡惨重。战斗结果目前尚不清楚。据说钮铁生（Nyeu Tih Sung）率五百人驻守吴江。他将指挥部设在一艘水警炮艇上。
据报，苏州道台尹宪宗（Yin Hsien Zung，音译）已弃职潜逃，现身处上海。
苏州和吴淞的居民正搭乘所有进沪列车抵达此地。
沪宁铁路于本月23日晚11时停止常规服务，今日列车仅运行至苏州。
昨天，二十箱夏季制服从吴淞运抵小礼拜堂（Chapel，指虹口靶子路附近军营），以便分发给该地驻军。
本月22日晚，方维宁（Fong Wei Nien）上校率领五百人离开

They travelled by the Shanghai Hangchow Railway.
A similar number of troops arrived from Woosung
at the Arsenal yesterday afternoon.
Great precautions are being taken in Woosieh
and Soochow, and nobody is allowed on the streets
after 6 p.m.
X It is reported that Chen Chi Mei 陳其美 is trying
to arrange to attack the Arsenal and set fire to various
places in the City.
X It is reported that a rebel officer named Liu
Vung Piau 片天標 has been nominated by a rebel leader
named Pah Wen Wei 柏文蔚 for the Tutuh of Zangzoh 常熟 .
It is reported that a police officer named Zi
Yao Ching 徐文青 of Tachong 太倉 has promised to give
the Shanghai rebels four hundred rifles.
It is reported that the rebels have sent an
ultimatum to General Woo Fong Ling 何丰林 of
Sungkiang demanding to have that City declare
independent within three days. General Woo has
applied to Military Governor Yang for instructions.
It is reported that Deputy Military Governor
Lu has received a private telegram from the President
stating that if he reconquer Chekiang he will be
made Chiangchun of that province.
The Shanghai rebels have sent twenty men to Tsingpoo
near Sungkiang.
At 3 a.m. 24th instant a big fire occurred
near the Ningpo Shaoshing godown on the Chinese Bund.
The cause of the outbreak is not yet known.

Entered on M.S.
Apl. 24.

Your Obedient Servant,
William Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

前往兵工厂附近的徽州会馆，目的地为本风泾（Foong Ching，音译）。
他们乘坐沪杭铁路列车前往。
昨日下午，同样数量的部队从吴淞抵达兵工厂。
吴淞和苏州方面戒备森严，下午6点后禁止任何人上街。
X 据报，陈其美（Chen Chi Mei）正试图策划攻击兵工厂并在市内多处纵火。
X 据报，一名名为刘云标（Liu Vung Piau，音译，原文汉字作“片天標”）的叛军军官，已被叛军首领柏文蔚（Pah Wen Wei）提名为常熟（Zangzoh，音译）都督。
据报，太仓（Tachong）一名名为徐文青（Zi Yao Ching，音译，原文汉字作“徐文青”）的警官承诺向上海叛军提供四百支步枪。
据报，叛军已向松江的何丰林（Woo Fong Ling，音译，原文汉字作“何丰林”）将军发出最后通牒，要求该城在三日内宣布独立。何将军已向杨督军请示指示。
据报，卢副督军收到总统发来的一封私人电报，称若其收复浙江，将被任命为该省将军（Chiangchun）。
上海叛军已派遣二十人前往松江附近的青浦。
本月24日凌晨3时，外滩华人地段宁波绍兴仓库附近发生大火。
起火原因目前尚不清楚。

录入于 M.S.
4月24日。

您顺从的仆人，
威廉·阿姆斯特朗 (William Armstrong)
首席探长。

警察总监。
